dedupe_keys.name: medium range water level ensemble forecasts for the rhine waterway bfg imprex

description: This dataset holds medium-range ensemble water level forecasts for the Rhine as a waterway, with the matching observed water levels, produced by the German Federal Institute of Hydrology (BfG) in the IMPREX project case studies on navigation. The forecasts were computed with the HBV hydrological model and the SOBEK hydraulic model of the Rhine, driven by a 68-member multi-model meteorological ensemble made of the 51 ECMWF ENS members, the higher-resolution ECMWF HRES and the 16 COSMO-LEPS members, and were used to test Ensemble Model Output Statistics post-processing for probabilistic water level forecasts for users of the waterway. The authors are Bastian Klein and Dennis Meissner, and the analyses are published in IMPREX deliverables 9.2 and 9.4. Coverage is regional (the Rhine). The data are free under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 on Zenodo as two NetCDF files, observations and a 564 MB forecast file, published in March 2020. Caveats: it is a research hindcast set, the non-commercial licence limits reuse, and it is not an operational forecast service. It supports low-water risk and transport cost studies for inland navigation and testing of forecast-based operations. It complements the BfG LARSIM-ME forecasts and projections for German waterways catalogued here.
